Core Methods

VetResearchLMM VetResearchLMM-package
VetResearchLMM: Linear Mixed Models for Veterinary Research Examples

Interpretation

report_mixed_model()
Report a Fitted Mixed Model

Post Hoc Inference

emmeans_mixed_model()
Estimated Marginal Means for a Fitted Mixed Model
